title: Transfer
description: Two lists and a shuttle: what is in, what is out, and the move between them, counted.
usage: For assigning things in bulk — members to a team, parts to a page, tags to a post. Each side filters itself, the buttons move only what is checked, and the counts always say how many are where.
a11y: Real checkboxes in two labelled groups; the move buttons say what they move ("Move selected right"), and the header checkbox per side selects that side only. Moving focus is left to the reader — nothing jumps.
